about: Names of things (technologies, products, brands, plants, partners) picked out of what was read, by code: 'MoReTec', 'CirculenRevive', 'APK'. They are searched for next, so a run follows what the sources name instead of rewording the question; and an inventory answer is grouped by them. A small model asked for follow-up searches wrote 'technologies list', 'technologies portfolio', 'technology names'. These words are never names: abbreviations of the trade, units, places and calendar words.
